::: {.iasi-epigraph}
*If implementation costs less and less, knowledge becomes more and more valuable.*
:::

IASI is an open ecosystem dedicated to exploring a new way of engineering. We believe that the emergence of Intelligent Systems represents a paradigm shift comparable to the arrival of the Internet, object-oriented programming or open source software. This is not simply about adopting new tools, but about rethinking how we conceive, design, build and evolve software systems.

IASI exists to explore that journey.

**Approach**

IASI does not start from a predefined methodology, we start from the problem, **without preconceptions**.

We believe that the emergence of Intelligent Systems requires us to rethink the way engineering is practiced. Therefore, we do not assume that existing methodologies, by themselves, provide the right answer.

Instead:

> **We do not adopt methodologies to solve problems. We start from problems to discover the methodology.**

Every need is evaluated independently.

- If an existing methodology provides the best answer, we will use it.
- If it needs to be adapted, we will adapt it.
- If combining multiple approaches provides a better solution, we will combine them.
- And if none is sufficient, we will build a new one.

We are not looking for a universal methodology.

We are looking for the best solution to every problem.

**Principles**

- Engineering comes first.
- Intelligent Systems are engineering assistants.
- Knowledge should be open.
- Documentation is an engineering artefact.
- Automation should be the consequence of good design, not an objective by itself.
- Components should be reusable.
- Every decision can be questioned.
- Methodologies must evolve as well.

**The Journey Is Knowledge**

IASI does not only publish results, it also documents the journey.

- Architectural decisions.
- Experiments.
- Questions.
- Mistakes.
- Changes of direction.
- Discarded tools.
- Ideas that worked... and those that did not.

We believe that understanding **how** a solution is built is as valuable as the solution itself.

That is why, in IASI, the journey is part of the product.

> *"The best methodology is not the one we follow, but the one we discover while solving the right problem."*



## Open by design {#contribute}

IASI begins as a personal initiative, but **it is not intended to be built alone or to belong to a single person, but to the community**.

Its ideas, methods and artifacts are developed openly so that others can use them, discuss them, challenge them and improve them.

**Professionals, teams and organizations are welcome to participate**, whether by contributing knowledge, proposing problems, developing new artifacts or experimenting with this way of understanding engineering.

IASI starts here. **What it becomes will also depend on those who choose to build it.**
